title: Recognition Video Stroke-Order Tail Spec
description: Sub-line C artifact. Owns the last ~2s stroke-order tail (米字格 writing demo + child hand pose). Independent of the cinematic body so that 换字 (character swap) cannot drift the final frame. Every field is a process constraint, not content design — content design lives in brief.shotPlan.

anchorsRef.description: Pointer to the system-level mizige-anchors.json. Validator asserts the referenced file matches schemaVersion so an outdated anchors copy cannot silently change layout.

glyph.description: How the kaiti glyph is rendered. source=html-kaiti uses CSS font-family fallback (STKaiti); source=svg uses an explicit path. boxOverride.allowed must be false in production — system anchor wins.

imageAsset.description: Required when source=image. Asset id resolved via asset-plan.

boxOverride.description: Per-character override of glyph box. allowed must be false except for exceptional characters (validator gates this).

strokeOrder.description: Ordered list of strokes the tail will animate. Each stroke references a supportedStrokeDirections code from mizige-anchors.

maskGradientOverrideDeg.description: Optional: deviate from mizige-anchors.supportedStrokeDirections gradient angle. Must be justified in notes.

container.description: Mizige container state policy. Only single-mizige-dual-state is allowed in production — never render two grids on screen, never swap to a fresh grid.

narrationPolicy.description: Stroke-order tail must be silent. Voice during writing demo distracts from the visual hand-tracing moment that primes P09 writing practice.

transition.description: How the tail enters from the cinematic body. clearLayerIds names DOM elements that MUST be removed/hidden when the tail starts. protectedLayerIds names the persistent kaiti glyph layer(s) that MUST survive the handoff so the child never sees appear→vanish→rewrite.

clearLayerIds.description: DOM element ids/classes from the cinematic body that MUST be removed or set to display:none when the tail enters. Failing this is the root cause of ghost-stroke bugs.

protectedLayerIds.description: DOM element ids/classes from the cinematic body that MUST survive the body→tail handoff (e.g. the persistent kaiti glyph that the child just learned to read). Validator asserts clearLayerIds ∩ protectedLayerIds == ∅. Root cause of the v8 appear→vanish→rewrite blocker was the persistent kaiti layer being listed in clearLayerIds with no protection enforced.

finalFrame.description: Hard requirements for the very last frame of the tail (used as P03 poster). pointerForm must match the rendered guide object so brief.finalFrame can be cross-checked against it.

posterReady.description: Final frame MUST be poster-ready (no transition mid-flight).

handPosePresent.description: Child's hand or brush pointer MUST be visible in the final frame — this is the brand-locked P03 poster moment.

pointerForm.description: Which pointer form is rendered. Must equal an entry in mizige-anchors.hand.allowedPointerForms AND must equal brief.finalFrame.guideObject.form. Cross-file consistency validator gates this. v9 added ink-front-bloom — see anchors.hand.description for rationale.

completedStrokeIndices.description: Which stroke indices must be fully visible in the final frame. Defaults to all when omitted.

composition.description: Standalone HTML composition file for the tail only (used for isolated rendering and screenshot).

finalFramePng.description: PNG of the very last frame. Used as P03 poster and as the screenshot product-review evaluates.

domProbeJson.description: JSON dump of mizige-anchors.domProbe assertions (which layers present, which removed). Validator gates the tail against this so screenshots alone cannot lie.
